text: 移動セル上のALEスカラー保存式 ALE scalar conservation on moving cells 移動セル上のALEスカラー保存式 q_t+a q_x=0,\quad m_i(t)=\int_{x_{i-1/2}(t)}^{x_{i+1/2}(t)}q(x,t)\,dx \dot m_i=-[(a-w)q]_{i-1/2}^{i+1/2},\qquad \dot V_i=w_{i+1/2}-w_{i-1/2} x(\xi,t)=\xi+\frac{.2}{2\pi}\sin(2\pi\xi)\sin(2\pi t),\quad a=.7 指定した非一様格子の面位置とセル質量を同じHeun段で更新し、幾何保存則と非一様な波の輸送を別々に評価します。Euler流体のLagrange/remap法ではありません。 ALE scalar conservation on moving cells q_t+a q_x=0,\quad m_i(t)=\int_{x_{i-1/2}(t)}^{x_{i+1/2}(t)}q(x,t)\,dx \dot m_i=-[(a-w)q]_{i-1/2}^{i+1/2},\qquad \dot V_i=w_{i+1/2}-w_{i-1/2} x(\xi,t)=\xi+\frac{.2}{2\pi}\sin(2\pi\xi)\sin(2\pi t),\quad a=.7 Prescribed nonuniform face positions and cell masses share Heun stages.
